fields.description: Direct DB delete — skips on_trash hooks, permissions, and link checks. Much faster but bypasses all validations.
fields.label: Skip Hooks (Direct DB Delete)

fields.description: Automatically detect and delete child table rows linked to the parent DocType.
fields.label: Delete Child Tables

fields.description: Automatically reorder DocTypes so linked parents are deleted after their children.
fields.label: Auto-order Dependencies

fields.description: Cancel submitted (docstatus=1) documents before deleting them. Required for submittable DocTypes like Sales Order, Sales Invoice, etc.
fields.label: Cancel Before Delete

fields.description: Automatically discover and include all connected documents (e.g., Delivery Note, Sales Invoice linked to a Sales Order). They will be cancelled and deleted in the correct dependency order.
fields.label: Include Connected Documents

fields.description: Number of parallel background workers (only used when Skip Hooks is off).
fields.label: Workers
